thread:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — Elevated 5xx & gateway timeouts on /v1/generate, detected 1767894319. Sev=2, paging jules (on-call SRE) and matt (eng-runtime).

jules: on it. seeing error spike and a bunch of backend 502/504s from gateway pool.

matt: I saw a correlated rise in prefix-kv misses and eviction metrics around 1767894200. Could be eviction storm.

jana (ana typo) sorry meant ana: grabbing prefix-cache dashboard now.

jules: customers reporting slower responses and ~10% 5xx across hosts in us-west. tagging liz to surface customer impact. @liz any high-touch customers hitting errors?

liz: I have 2 active enterprise customers on Dedicated noticing failed requests, they're seeing timeouts in the last ~10m. CS is on standby.

ops-bot: autop-run: `rk diagnostics prefix-kv --since 5m --top-errors`

ops-bot: result: increased eviction_rate on shard-38, KV read latency spike, and intermittent checksum-mismatch logs: `kv: checksum mismatch key=prefix:abc123`

matt: checksum mismatch + eviction spike = either corrupted index or rebuild/retry thrash. Could be caused by the deploy earlier today (quantization cache change).

jules: rollbacks? anyone rolled cache config today?

matt: @sam pushed `enable_prefetch=true` to prefetch service at 09:02 UTC, then a config wide refresh at 09:10. Noticed sustained prefetch churn after that.

jules: mitigation plan: 1) disable prefetch at edge, 2) flip gateway fallback to bypass prefix cache for critical routes, 3) restart kv-worker on shard-38 with safe-recover, 4) open customer comms. Starting step 1 now.

matt: dropping prefetch: `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/prefetch PREFETCH_ENABLED=false --record`

ops-bot: executed: prefetch env set to false in prod (propagating).

jules: monitoring TTLs and eviction rate.

(2m later)

ops-bot: alert resolved: prefetch disabled propagating, eviction_rate dropping but still elevated.

matt: flipping gateway route policy to route /v1/generate to bypass prefix-cache for 10% of traffic (canary) — command `gatewayctl route update --bypass-prefix-cache=10% --route /v1/generate`

jules: canary in place. observing 5xx on bypassed vs regular.

matt: preliminary: bypass reduced 5xx by 60% for those sessions. So prefix-cache path is implicated.

jules: start safe restart of kv-worker on shard-38 with `kvctl restart shard-38 --safe-recover --pause-traffic` — coordinate traffic pause with gateway.

ops-bot: pausing traffic to shard-38 nodes 10.12.7.3/10.12.7.4, estimated impact minimal due to redundancy.

sam: I'll take the restart. tailing logs: `grep -n "checksum mismatch" /var/log/kv/kv-38.log | tail -n 50` shows repeated checksum mismatch followed by eviction events.

sam: restart complete. running `kvctl scrub shard-38 --repair` now.

(5m later)

ops-bot: scrub finished: 232 anomalous entries repaired, no unfixable segments. Eviction_rate trending down.

matt: pushing a temporary rule to increase KV read retry backoff to avoid thrash while caches warm: `servicectl update inference --kv-retry-backoff=200ms`

jules: set. watching error rates.

(10m later)

jules: 5xx dropped from 9.8% -> 1.4% cluster-wide, timeouts reduced. Gateway timeouts still occasionally spiking in eu-west-1, but magnitude smaller.

liz: shared initial customer note: "We're seeing intermittent failures earlier but service is recovering. We'll follow up with timeline." CS will send detailed impact if customers request.

matt: follow-up: we should roll back `enable_prefetch` change in config repo and open a postmortem. Also we need to add a safety threshold on prefetch concurrency to prevent future thrash.

jules: agreed. action items: 
- sam: file rollback PR and pin prefetch to 0 by default until we QA.
- matt: create runbook entry for checksum-mismatch + eviction storms.
- ana: collect flamegraphs and heap metrics from prefix-cache nodes between 09:00-09:20.
- liz: draft customer-facing incident note and coordinate with CS.

sam: filed PR: `repo:prefetch/config` #428 revert prefetch toggle and add safety limit.

matt: adding runbook draft to docs/incidents/prefix-kv-eviction-runbook.md (will link once done).

jules: status update for pager: most mitigations applied, we are lowering severity to sev=3 monitoring. Will keep thread open until stable for 30m.

pagerduty-bot: Incident severity changed to 3 by jules.

(20m later)

jules: everything looks stable. eviction_rate back to baseline, no new checksum mismatches in last 12m. moving to recovery.

ops-bot: summary metrics: 5xx peak 12m ago at 12.3% -> now 0.9%. Read latency per-token reduced from 220ms->95ms.

liz: customer comms scheduled in 15m with timeline and next steps.

matt: we'll schedule a deeper postmortem; suspected root cause: prefetch change causing concurrent rebuilds that exposed a latent KV checksum race on shard-38. Need integrity tests and a safer repair path.

jules: oncall handoff: I'm staying until postmortem draft. @ana you take next oncall rotation from 1767897600.

ana (ana typo) ana: ack, I'll pick up the next rotation and help with data collection.

pagerduty-bot: incident closed by jules after stabilization (notes: mitigate by disabling prefetch, scrubbed shard-38, increased kv-retry backoff, opened rollback PR).

jules: final note — if anyone sees checksum mismatch resurrecting, escalate to pager and ping me. great job team :thumbsup:
